summary: The root لعن (lEn) can refer to the base or lower part of a palm tree's raceme. This is a less common meaning, found in specialized lexicon entries.
lane: لَعِينٌ ذ The base, or lower part, of a raceme of a palm-tree. (TA in art. عهن .)
